function.description:
Retrieves licensing settings, including Default/Active Licensing Smart Account ID.

**Execution Policy (MANDATORY):**
- Use this tool directly for licensing requests about active/default smart account settings.
- Do NOT ask users whether they mean Licensing or PnP Smart Accounts.
- Treat this tool as Licensing context only.

**Dependency Guidance:**
- If response returns only Smart Account ID, resolve the display name/domain using `api_smartAccountDetails` before final response when needed.
function.name: api_retrieveLicenseSetting
